free_text.inst.v2.D8:
It begins by calling me quick-minded and talkative, at home with words and dealing. That is not me and has never been me. I have spent a lifetime being described by people who did not know me, and this page is one more of those descriptions. Words were the thing I had least of; I was best when the camera ran and no one spoke.

Some of it lands. Money and what I have put by, yes - that has been solid, and it was the one part of my affairs I attended to myself, carefully, for a long time. Living far from where I was born, and the inner life kept apart from everything else: it calls that mixed, and mixed is honest. It says work and standing read hard, and I would not argue, though the world would - the work went well and it cost me everything I had, so perhaps we mean the same thing by different words.

But it is unusually positive, it says, about children and about my father. I had no children. My father died when I was fourteen; I nursed him and then I went out to work, and the house was never the same after. If those are the places to test the method, the method has failed the test in my case. I mention it not to be unkind. It says so itself - test it there.

I would not pay much for it, and I would not want my name on it.

notes: Answered in persona as Greta Garbo (b. 18 Sep 1905 Stockholm, d. 1990), having read the prepared reading first. Where the reading and the documented life conflict, the life was answered: reading calls the temperament quick-minded/talkative (she was famously reserved and silent -> B1 opt1, A30 reserved/solitary), calls father and family life unusually favourable (father died when she was 14, sister Alva died 1926, childhood poverty -> A10 died_early, C6 opt2, C7 opt2), and calls children favourable (she had none -> C1 opt1, but confidence lowered to 2 as visible contamination). Contamination also shows in D8 free text, which argues directly with the plain-English page, and in higher confidence on money/acquisitions (C8, C12) where reading and life agree. A25 (marriage year) omitted - never married. A36 (since mid-2023) answered 'same' as the least distorting response to an anachronistic item. B6#4 own_surgery is dated approximately.
